title: Creator Engine Pro v2.0.0 is Live! 🎉
preview: Introducing Media Studio! A brand-new feature with Native OS Dialogs, Colorful Console...
body:
What's new in the v2.0.0 Mega Update:

• Brand New Feature - Media Studio: An offline, lightning-fast media editor powered by FFmpeg! It comes with auto-overwrite (-y), seamless progress streaming, and a dedicated Force Kill switch.

• Native OS File Picker: Say goodbye to annoying browser prompts! Media Studio uses native Windows dialogs to select input files and output folders.

• Colorful Human-Readable Console: Technical gibberish is gone. The processing console now displays beautiful, color-coded live progress (Time & Speed).

• Dynamic Help & GitHub Integration: The entire Help Documentation is now dynamic, and the Settings menu fetches live version history directly from GitHub without any tokens.

title: Creator Engine Pro v1.1.0 is Live! 🚀
preview: The 'Master Orchestrator' update is here with Custom GPT integration...
body:
Highlights of the previous release:

• Custom Administrator GPT: A highly trained, strict orchestration engine that manages AI workers without hallucinating.

• Workflow State Machine: The system now strictly follows isolated states (Planning, Dispatching, Reviewing).

• Human Approval Gate: The Administrator will wait for your explicit 'Dispatch' command before routing any data.

title: Creator Engine Pro v1.0.1 is Live! ✨
preview: Multi-browser core (Super 7) and advanced stealth error handling are now active...
body:
Highlights of the previous release:

• Super 7 Browsers: Added full automated integration for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, Firefox, and Tor Browser.

• Universal Extractor: Implemented a 3-Tier fallback logic to completely eliminate 'Extraction Failed' bugs.

• Premium UI: 3D Cyberpunk consoles, animated HOT / PRO badges applied globally.
